subject.title: feat(durable): hand off wakes to session queue

question: Should a resolved durable wake remain bound to the session generation that owned it, or may it be delivered to a new generation sharing the same logical session key after reset?
rationale: Both behaviors are technically implementable, but they encode different session-state and stale-context policies that existing queue mechanics cannot choose automatically.

options.title: Bind to session generation
options.body: Record the resolved session ID and leave the wake pending or inspectable when that generation no longer matches, preventing stale wake context from entering a reset session.

options.title: Follow the logical key
options.body: Explicitly permit delivery into a replacement session generation and document and test that resets do not discard outstanding durable obligations.

options.title: Defer automatic handoff
options.body: Keep durable wakes inspection-only until the reset-ownership policy is settled.

recommendation.title: Bind to session generation
recommendation.body: Record the resolved session ID and leave the wake pending or inspectable when that generation no longer matches, preventing stale wake context from entering a reset session.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision directly extends the session-delivery queue and reset-generation contract introduced in their merged restart-continuation work.
